desc: Stanley walks in laughing hard, eyes half-closed, passing Pam, Jim, and Andy at reception.
A close-up shot of someone holding a banner with an ad featuring Andy.
Dwight runs out of the office, through the street and park, and shouts at the sight of a large ad banner featuring him and Andy.
An outraged Dwight shouts with his mouth wide open on a street lined with lots of greenery.
A shot of Dwight drawing a map on a whiteboard.
Andy puts a laptop on the desk in front of people and clicks play on it.
Andy points at something in the video playing on the laptop.
Jim shows something on his computer screen while Dwight watches with interest, both seated at their desks.
Pam sits with Angela in the office cafeteria, eating with her bare feet up on another chair.
Andy ties his shoe with his foot up on the desk.
A blue car drives onto the property past a mailbox and stops next to a man in a vest and bow tie.
A man in a vest and bow tie struggles to pull Toby out of the car.
A speeding blue car races down a dirt road and drives into a field of tall green and yellow plants.
Erin and Kelly talk by a table with a checkered cloth and sunflowers in a garden tent.
Dwight, dressed in vintage period costume, stands stiffly by a porch as Ryan walks past him with a pipe in his mouth.
Jim and Pam, with the stroller and a kid on Jim's arm, walk past Dwight standing stiffly by the porch.
Erin, wearing a large autumn hat, stands outside with Kelly when a bird snatches her hat away.
Kevin gorges on snacks from a waiter's tray, putting a finger to the waiter's lips as he tries to leave.
Dwight dances strangely with a maid, waving a light scarf, as people watch in the garden.
A man parks his car in a tight spot between other cars and gets out through the sunroof.
Darryl and smiling Jim sit at a table decorated with sunflowers.
Ryan is stuck up high on a seesaw while Kevin sits down at the bottom.
Erin shakes a small tree where her hat got stuck.
Dwight stands stiffly in the middle as waiters and maids around him freeze in a dance pose, arms outstretched.
Andy walks past a waiter with his guitar, knocking his tray and scattering food.
A man in a helmet on a scooter speeds toward a ramp set up in front of a row of cars.
A man in a helmet runs up a ramp set beside a row of cars and jumps across them.
Kelly rubs her arms, cold, while Ryan drinks beside her at a table with wine bottles, at the outdoor party.
Oscar, Darryl, Pam, Jim, and Erin sit at a table with sunflowers and drinks, listening to a baby monitor with worried expressions.
Ryan puts his jacket on a man, and a moment later a tall man does the same, at the outdoor party.
Jim stands beside Phyllis, both holding drinks at outdoor party, as Jim awkwardly waves at someone, looking uncomfortable.
Oscar throws a can toward Andy at an outdoor party.
Dwight stands in the middle, holding a torch, as waiters and maids circle around him, raising their torches.
A wide outdoor shot of people at picnic tables and blankets, Darryl and Kevin at the front, all looking the same way.
Dwight, dressed in a period costume with a black top hat,  stands stone-faced while Jim nods and looks up.
